name: Pagination Balance 1
definition: Balance of a financial instrument for a specific statement page.

FirstOpeningBalance.name: First Opening Balance
FirstOpeningBalance.definition: Opening balance of the financial instrument in the statement.

IntermediaryOpeningBalance.name: Intermediary Opening Balance
IntermediaryOpeningBalance.definition: Opening balance of this page only. It must be the interemdiary closing balance of the previous page (part of the same statement).

FinalClosingBalance.name: Final Closing Balance
FinalClosingBalance.definition: Closing balance of the financial instrument in the statement.

IntermediaryClosingBalance.name: Intermediary Closing Balance
IntermediaryClosingBalance.definition: Closing Balance of this page only. Must be the interemdiary opening balance of the next page (part of the same statement).

FirstOpeningBalanceOrIntermediaryOpening.definition: Either FirstOpeningBalance or IntermediaryOpeningBalance may be present, but not both.

FinalClosingBalanceOrIntermediaryClosing.definition: Either FinalClosingBalance or IntermediaryClosingBalance may be present, but not both.
